ios.desc:
Aigli is a all-in-one editor for creating both photos and videos on iPhone.
Design with layered tools for images, text, shapes, drawing, collage, and vector paths.
Fine-tune with crop, color controls, blend modes, masks, shadows, glow, and opacity adjustments.
Edit video on a multi-track timeline with trim, split, speed control, transitions, overlays, text animation, stickers, audio editing, and voiceover recording.
Use blur/mosaic masks with tracking for faces or moving subjects.
Export sharp PNG/JPEG images and MP4 videos up to 4K, then save or share instantly.

Functions available after Monthly Subscription, or Yearly Subscription or Perpetual license:
4k video export
Video not limited to 10 minutes
Hdr effect in image editor
Background removal for image edit
Mask effect for image edit
Video overlay for video edit
Subtitle generation by voice recognition for video edit
Mask face or object tracker for video edit
Replace color function in image editor
